name: Single-Leg Balance
steps: Stand tall on a flat floor near a sturdy wall or chair for optional light support.
Shift your weight smoothly onto one foot with a soft unlocked knee and lift your opposite foot off the ground.
Keep your hips level, gaze fixed on a steady point ahead, and make subtle ankle adjustments to stay balanced.
Hold steadily for the target duration, set your foot down gently, and switch legs.
tips: Spread your toes and ground through your heel, big toe, and little toe for a stable tripod base.
Keep your lifted hip level instead of letting your pelvis tilt downward.
